As Alliance Data Systems (ADS) Shares Declined, Caisse De Depot Et Placement Du Quebec Upped Holding; Marathon Pete (MPC) Holder Capital City Trust Company Has Raised Holding
May 9, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Caisse De Depot Et Placement Du Quebec increased its stake in Alliance Data Systems Corp (ADS) by 73.43% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Caisse De Depot Et Placement Du Quebec bought 223,600 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.04% with the market. The institutional investor held 528,111 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $133.87M, up from 304,511 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Caisse De Depot Et Placement Du Quebec who had been investing in Alliance Data Systems Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $11.38 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.72% or $3.47 $205.22. About 585,790 shares traded. Alliance Data Systems Corporation (NYSE:ADS) has declined 9.99% since May 9, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.54% the S&P500.
